**Record** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public sealed record PrinterCapabilities
```

What a printer can do, as reported by its print system.

An empty list, or a `null` value, means the print system didn't say, not that the printer can't. Lists never contain the `PrinterDefault` values.

Records compare lists by reference, so two capability records read separately are not equal even when they describe the same printer. Compare the lists' contents instead, and compare paper sizes by [MediaSize.Name](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/mediasize/#name).

### VendorOptions

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<VendorOption> VendorOptions { get; init; }
```

Gets the printer's other settings, such as print quality, finishing or a driver's own settings, with the keys and values to set them through [PrintOptions.VendorOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#vendoroptions).

IPP printers and CUPS queues list the job attributes they accept with their supported values, under `ipp:` keys. Windows printers list their driver's Print Capabilities features and parameters, under `windows:feature:` and `windows:parameter:` keys. Settings the typed options cover aren't listed.
